title: GiveSets
description: A plugin that allows you to easily give any players sets of armor with different levels!
body:
This plugin allows you to give any player on your server a set of armor.

Use:

/giveset player material level (optional:) extra turtle

player is the player(s) you will give it to

material is the material (leather -> netherite)

level (1-6) is the level (1: plain armor, 2: prot 1 unbr 1, 3: prot 2 unbr 2, 4: prot 3 unbr 3, 5: prot 4 unbr 3 mending, 6: prot 5 unbr 5 mending)

extra adds the extra enchants (aqua affinity, switf sneak, feather falling, etc.)

turtle changes the helmet to a turtle shell

(thorns support coming later)
